# Trend Reader

> A living, weekly-updated reference of the terms that matter in AI, each explained for executives, investors and technologists and connected to the ideas it depends on. Written and maintained by Andreas Proesch (https://andreasproesch.com).

Every term has a page with an executive explainer, a deeper dive, its relations (prerequisites, part of, contrasts with, related), the terms that need it, and sample sources linking to original articles. Importance is graph connectivity, never volume of coverage.

## Start here

- [Home](https://andproe.github.io/trend-reader/index.html): this week's new terms and the key terms to know
- [Glossary](https://andproe.github.io/trend-reader/terms.html): every term, sortable by connectivity
- [Weekly brief](https://andproe.github.io/trend-reader/research.html): the terms and themes to know this week, what moved in the graph, questions to research
- [Knowledge map](https://andproe.github.io/trend-reader/graph.html): the interactive graph
- [About](https://andproe.github.io/trend-reader/about.html): method and author

## Machine-readable

- [terms.json](https://andproe.github.io/trend-reader/terms.json): every term with definition, type, category, aliases, relations and URL
- [feed.xml](https://andproe.github.io/trend-reader/feed.xml): RSS of weekly briefs and new terms
- [sitemap.xml](https://andproe.github.io/trend-reader/sitemap.xml)

## Term pages

URL pattern: https://andproe.github.io/trend-reader/terms/<id>.html. Each carries schema.org DefinedTerm JSON-LD. Terms are ideas and technology, never companies.
